child_drafts.description_long: At a February 12, 2026 event hosted by the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum called the energy transition an ideological “fantasy” and questioned climate projections. E&E News reported his remarks as he discussed expanded fossil-fuel and critical-mineral development. The article says Burgum described climate forecasts as based on incomplete data and likened belief in the energy transition to a “semi-religion.” It also records his comments about the administration’s Project Vault critical-mineral reserve proposal and the possibility of expanding it if market demand justified doing so. The report situates the speech alongside the administration’s efforts to reverse climate policy, including EPA’s repeal of the endangerment finding. These are attributed descriptions of what Burgum said and the policy context reported that day; they do not establish his remarks as a formal Interior order or a new lease action. The Alaska lease sale occurred separately on March 18, 2026, and should have its own record.
